title: Mounting flange (Version 1, drawing MF-002)
general_tolerance_note: ISO 2768-1; 1st angle projection; all units in mm; break all sharp edges; surface roughness Ra 1.6 µm or better; finish: as-machined

expected_dimensions.feature: overall plate length (view A)
distance between outer corner-hole centres (view A)
left corner-hole to large-bore horizontal spacing (chain dim)
horizontal spacing between the two large bores (chain dim)
right corner-hole to large-bore horizontal spacing (chain dim)
overall plate height (view A)
vertical hole-centre spacing (view A)
edge margin from plate edge to corner-hole centre
corner / web radius at the bottom cut-out (view A)
2 large bores Ø20.0 THRU ALL (view A)
counterbore diameter for the large bores
counterbore depth for the large bores
4 corner clearance holes Ø8.5 THRU ALL (view A)
counterbore diameter for the 4 corner holes
counterbore depth for the 4 corner holes
section B-B overall width
2 corner radii R2.0 in section B-B
boss outer diameter in section B-B
boss / spigot diameter in section B-B
central bore diameter in section B-B
axial length / step in section B-B
axial length / step in section B-B
counterbore diameter (Ø32.0) dimensioned in section A-A (same counterbore as GD-11)
web / spacing dimension between bores in section A-A
web radius between the two bores in section A-A
counterbore diameter in detail C (4:1), typical 4 places
counterbore depth in detail C (4:1)
counterbore / countersink lead-in angle in detail C (4:1)
overall part thickness in the side view
step / flange thickness in the side view
general surface roughness Ra 1.6 µm (notes)

scoring.match_rule: An LLM-extracted dimension matches a GT entry if (a) kind matches OR is a compatible alias, (b) numerical value within ±0.05 (mm precision), (c) tolerances within ±0.05 if specified. Compound counterbore annotations like '4 × Ø8.5 THRU ALL ⌴ Ø14.0 ▽ 8.5' are split into separate GT entries (hole pattern + counterbore diameter + counterbore depth); the model gets credit for each independently.
scoring.passing_threshold: Strong = recall and precision >= 0.85; Pass = both >= 0.70.
